test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting in a circle facing the centre. S is to the right of R, P is to the left of N and right of L, R is to the right of O and O is to the right of N. If Q is the right of S, then who is to the right of M?
solution: The logic followed here is :- L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting in a circle facing the centre. 1) S is to the right of R and R is to the right of O and O is to the right of N.
